use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::thread;

const N: u64 = 1_000_000_000;
// Bit i of the odd-only sieve represents the number 2*i + 1.
const SEG_BITS: u64 = 1 << 17; // 16 KiB per segment, fits in L1

fn base_primes(limit: usize) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut s = vec![true; limit + 1];
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for i in 2..=limit {
        if s[i] {
            if i > 2 {
                out.push(i as u32);
            }
            let mut j = i * i;
            while j <= limit {
                s[j] = false;
                j += i;
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

fn main() {
    let m: u64 = N / 2; // odd numbers 1, 3, ..., N-1
    let root = (N as f64).sqrt() as usize + 1;
    let primes = base_primes(root);
    let nseg = ((m + SEG_BITS - 1) / SEG_BITS) as usize;
    let next = AtomicUsize::new(0);
    let threads = thread::available_parallelism().map_or(1, |n| n.get());

    let total: u64 = thread::scope(|sc| {
        let hs: Vec<_> = (0..threads)
            .map(|_| {
                sc.spawn(|| {
                    let mut buf = vec![0u64; (SEG_BITS / 64) as usize];
                    let mut count = 0u64;
                    loop {
                        let s = next.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        if s >= nseg {
                            break;
                        }
                        let lo = s as u64 * SEG_BITS;
                        let hi = (lo + SEG_BITS).min(m);
                        let len = hi - lo;
                        let words = ((len + 63) / 64) as usize;
                        let buf = &mut buf[..words];
                        buf.fill(0);
                        let first = 2 * lo + 1;
                        let last = 2 * hi - 1;
                        for &p in &primes {
                            let p = p as u64;
                            if p * p > last {
                                break;
                            }
                            let mut mult = if p * p >= first {
                                p * p
                            } else {
                                (first + p - 1) / p * p
                            };
                            if mult & 1 == 0 {
                                mult += p;
                            }
                            let mut idx = (mult - 1) / 2 - lo;
                            while idx < len {
                                buf[(idx >> 6) as usize] |= 1u64 << (idx & 63);
                                idx += p;
                            }
                        }
                        // Mark padding bits in the final word as composite.
                        let pad = words as u64 * 64 - len;
                        if pad > 0 {
                            buf[words - 1] |= !0u64 << (64 - pad);
                        }
                        let ones: u64 = buf.iter().map(|w| w.count_ones() as u64).sum();
                        count += words as u64 * 64 - ones;
                    }
                    count
                })
            })
            .collect();
        hs.into_iter().map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).sum()
    });

    // +1 for the prime 2, -1 because 1 (bit 0) is counted as non-composite.
    println!("{}", total);
}

<parameter name="content">use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::process;

fn main() {
    let path = match env::args().nth(1) {
        Some(p) => p,
        None => {
            eprintln!("usage: wordfreq <file>");
            process::exit(1);
        }
    };

    let text = match fs::read_to_string(&path) {
        Ok(t) => t,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("error reading {}: {}", path, e);
            process::exit(1);
        }
    };

    let mut counts: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    for word in text
        .split(|c: char| !c.is_alphanumeric() && c != '\'')
        .map(|w| w.trim_matches('\''))
        .filter(|w| !w.is_empty())
    {
        *counts.entry(word.to_lowercase()).or_insert(0) += 1;
    }

    let mut entries: Vec<(&String, &usize)> = counts.iter().collect();
    // Highest count first; ties broken alphabetically for stable output.
    entries.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(a.1).then(a.0.cmp(b.0)));

    for (word, count) in entries.into_iter().take(10) {
        println!("{:>6}  {}", count, word);
    }
}

<parameter name="content">package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
)

type wordCount struct {
	word  string
	count int
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "usage: %s <file>\n", os.Args[0])
		os.Exit(2)
	}

	f, err := os.Open(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer f.Close()

	counts := make(map[string]int)
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), 1024*1024)
	scanner.Split(bufio.ScanWords)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		w := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimFunc(scanner.Text(), func(r rune) bool {
			return !unicode.IsLetter(r) && !unicode.IsDigit(r)
		}))
		if w != "" {
			counts[w]++
		}
	}
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	list := make([]wordCount, 0, len(counts))
	for w, c := range counts {
		list = append(list, wordCount{w, c})
	}
	sort.Slice(list, func(i, j int) bool {
		if list[i].count != list[j].count {
			return list[i].count > list[j].count
		}
		return list[i].word < list[j].word
	})

	if len(list) > 10 {
		list = list[:10]
	}
	for _, wc := range list {
		fmt.Printf("%6d  %s\n", wc.count, wc.word)
	}
}
